Myanmar seeks closer foreign ties amid global isolation
items.description: Myanmar coup leader Min Aung Hlaing has been on a diplomatic offensive since becoming president in April, but foreign friends may still be few and far between.

items.title: Ethiopia's Tigray rebels accuse govt of new drone strike
items.description: Rebel Tigrayan authorities accused Ethiopia of another drone strike in the country's northern region on Tuesday. The federal government has launched multiple drone strikes in Tigray in recent weeks and massed troops at the regional border, raising fears of a return to the civil war of 2020-2022 that killed some 600,000…

items.description: Riyadh needs to restore deterrence without being pulled back into a prolonged Yemen war.

items.title: From Russia With Expertise: Iranian Students Return Home With Potentially Deadly Knowledge Of Drones, AI, And More
items.description: Iranians studying in Russia often work on projects with military applications, an analysis by Systema shows -- and upon return, some join entities linked to Iran’s armed forces. These ties are growing: The number of Iranians studying at Russian universities has jumped during Moscow’s war on Ukraine.

items.title: UN peacekeepers give NPR a rare look behind Israeli lines
items.description: NPR accompanies UN peacekeepers behind Israeli lines as Israel expands its occupation of South Lebanon following a U.S.-brokered ceasefire.

items.title: Tens of millions of people fail to get humanitarian aid as global system crumbles
items.description: Funding cuts in 2025 left women, children, older and displaced people hard hit, with 64m fewer people receiving aidThe humanitarian aid system is crumbling as funding shrinks, pressures increase and governments not only fail to protect civilians but are increasingly responsible for endangering them, a new report warned…

items.title: Bayeux Tapestry exhibition at British Museum opens
items.description: The British Museum has so far sold a record 100,000 tickets for the highly anticipated showing of the medieval artwork depicting the 1066 Battle of Hastings.

items.title: As Israel’s ‘capital of the north’ seeks to recover from war, it’s too quiet
items.description: Tens of thousands of Israelis were evacuated from their homes near the border with Lebanon. Many of them have still not returned.

items.title: Russia Says It Expects Ukraine Peace Talks to Resume as Deadly Attack Hits Kyiv
items.description: Russia says it expects trilateral talks with Ukraine and the US to resume, even as its forces launched a deadly attack on Kyiv. Peskov also welcomed US and Indian peace efforts and accused Kyiv of prolonging the war.

items.title: In Gaza, women-headed households face ‘impossible choices’ to survive
items.description: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.
